name: On Thin Ice
source:
A tragic incident divides your life into two: before, and the dark path you descend after losing sight of your future. There is a light at the end of this tunnel. What will you do to reach it?

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/On_Thin_Ice]romance-club.fandom[/url]
translation:
一场悲惨的事件将你的生活分成两部分：之前的生活，以及在失去未来之后走上的黑暗道路。这条隧道的尽头有一盏灯。为了达到这个目标你会做什么？

来自 [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/On_Thin_Ice]romance-club.fandom[/url]
